title: Quiz: Building an AI Agent With LangGraph and Python
description: Test your understanding of LangGraph state graphs, nodes, edges, and tools, and see how well you can follow an AI agent through its workflow.
summary: In this quiz, you’ll test your understanding of Building an AI Agent With LangGraph and Python . The course builds an email-processing agent that reads an incoming email, decides which of its tools to call, and pulls structured details out of the message.
takeaways: By working through this quiz, you’ll revisit how LangGraph models a workflow as a state graph, how nodes and edges fit together, and how an agent decides when it needs a tool.
The course builds an email-processing agent that reads an incoming email, decides which of its tools to call, and pulls structured details out of the message.

You’ll also revisit the state itself, which is the central memory object that every node in your graph can read from and update.
